description: This file contains a custom assertion class PropertySearchFilterAssert for verifying properties of PropertySearchFilter objects in unit tests. It utilizes AssertJ for fluent assertions and is intended for testing search filter functionality within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: PropertySearchFilterAssert
classes.description: A fluent assertion class for verifying properties of PropertySearchFilter objects, such as path and values, in tests.

methods.name: hasPath
methods.description: Asserts that the PropertySearchFilter has a specific JsonPointer path.

methods.name: hasNoValue
methods.description: Asserts that the PropertySearchFilter has no values.

methods.name: hasOnlyValue (JsonValue...)
methods.description: Asserts that the PropertySearchFilter has exactly the specified JsonValues.

methods.name: hasOnlyValue (String...)
methods.description: Asserts that the PropertySearchFilter has only the specified String values, converted to JsonValues.

methods.name: hasOnlyValue (Boolean...)
methods.description: Asserts that the PropertySearchFilter has only the specified Boolean values, converted to JsonValues.

methods.name: hasOnlyValue (Integer...)
methods.description: Asserts that the PropertySearchFilter has only the specified Integer values, converted to JsonValues.

methods.name: hasOnlyValue (Long...)
methods.description: Asserts that the PropertySearchFilter has only the specified Long values, converted to JsonValues.

methods.name: hasOnlyValue (Double...)
methods.description: Asserts that the PropertySearchFilter has only the specified Double values, converted to JsonValues.
